sources.title: PDF Schema Matching using Pre-Trained Language Models
sources.snippet: The customer-imposed constraints discussed in Section I, along with the challenges of real-world customer schemata, render near-100% accuracy virtually impossible. We thus believe that a combination of a reasonably good model with human-in-the-loop intervention in a targeted fashion is likely the best way to improve the schema matching process.
